text: 4.26 Description of an Advance Authorisation An Advance Authorisation shall, inter-alia, specify: (a) Names and description of items including specifications, where applicable, to be imported and exported/supplied; (b) Quantity of each item to be imported or wherever quantity cannot be indicated, value of item shall be indicated. Wherever, quantity and value of individual inputs is a limiting factor in SION, same shall be applicable; (c) Aggregate CIF value of imports; (d) FOB/FOR value and quantity of exports/supplies; and (e) Validity period of import and Export Obligation Period. 4.26 Description of an Advance Authorisation An Advance Authorisation shall, inter-alia, specify: (a) Names and description of items including specifications, where applicable, to be imported and exported/supplied; (b) Quantity of each item to be imported or wherever quantity cannot be indicated, value of item shall be indicated.
